narrative.overview:
This is a **preview-local implementation record**, extracted from [index.html](index.html) on 6 November 2026 and checked against the saved week desktop screenshot. Frontmatter tokens describe this prototype only; the HTML remains the implemented source. No winning layout, production palette, public brand, logo or native-client design has been selected.

The current surface uses a cool pale navigation shell, white working space, blue actions, lilac group events and ochre friend events. Compact system type, date anchors and thin rules make dense schedules readable. Week, Agenda and Planner are alternative structures with shared sample data and vocabulary. Their provisional direction is recorded in the [surface brief](../../.impeccable/surfaces/docs-mockups-index-html.md); durable product constraints remain in [PRODUCT.md](../../PRODUCT.md).
keyCharacteristics: Three unselected layouts for the same personal and shared planning product.
Date-led working surfaces, thin dividers and compact system typography.
Colour identifies context alongside explicit words for availability and state.
Self-contained HTML, CSS and inline SVG with fictional, in-memory data.
dos: Do use this capture to reproduce and compare the current prototype locally.
Do preserve labelled availability, privacy and attendance states alongside colour.
Do retain visible focus, readable phone alternatives and the fictional-data notice.
Do consult the HTML and surface brief when a component or layout changes.
donts: Don't treat these tokens or any of the three layouts as an approved production identity.
Don't turn an empty calendar into declared availability or a candidate reply into attendance.
Don't promote the comparison switcher or sample group into the production feature set.
Don't invent new fonts, imagery, colour ramps or interaction states from this capture.
